page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor running at 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average performance across several standard workloads. The instance achieves average ratings in Passmark CPU and memory scores, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations. However, multi-core computational performance shows limitations, with stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression falling into the bottom 25% tier. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks is also weak, though read-only memory bandwidth remains in the middle 50% range.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, basic database operations, and software compilation. However, it is poorly suited for resource-intensive tasks like medium-sized language model inference, where it registers in the bottom 10% for performance. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment for persistent data needs.
